This week I'll be posting previews of the future scenes remakes and the preview of Chapter 3 too.

notes.title: New Update: Chapter 1 Part 2, Chapter 2, New Content and Major Changes.
notes.notes:
The new update will be available this week, check out the following additions and changes.

[h1]Full Chapter 1[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719623/fa80259a984a33895064a9202cefafb657ff8b9a.png[/img]

The entire Chapter 1 is fully available, this update adds the second half of the chapter and delves a little deeper in the game world, showing more of the Faye World and the Goddess Mother, Mithra. This chapter also introduces some new secondary characters and starts the introduction to the Beneventi Family.

[h1]Chapter 2[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719623/489a35d740dc2f593d87dc92fd4573a0f24b1e00.png[/img]

Chapter 2 is fully available, this chapter introduces the whole Beneventi Family and delves more on the main character relationship with them.

[h1]New and Improved Character Models[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719623/e2a7a859183c9aa729c93ac9278836fc5980ac88.png[/img]

Many characters got a new and more improved model, the reason was that the previous models, were causing trouble for me, one of them was being way too heavy and making it more difficult to pose and render the scenes. Characters will also get new hairstyles and outfits as the story progress.

Characters that got updated models: Magno Beneventi, Reina, Cornelio Fortuna (The Butler), Nemora (Potion Shop Faye), The Assassin, Alecto (Chapter 3), Lucia (Chapter 4), Veronika Ivanov (Chapter 4).

Characters that will get updated models: Mr.Hamada, Kichiro (Hamada's Son).

[h1]Scenes Remake[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719623/fa60f627ad2c356d2bfefa0c2f623e68fddd7abf.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719623/8723484e0e35cfd561103500b3323d2bce9c7919.png[/img]

Many scenes got a remake, better lighting, setting, cameras and poses. After Chapter 2 is out, I'll be releasing updates with other updated scenes from Chapter 1 and 2.

Scenes that got a remake: Potion Shop, Mithra Introduction, The Beneventi Dinner.
Scenes that will get a remake: Clothing Shop, All Reina Scenes, Meeting with Mr.Hamada.

[h1]Translations[/h1]
New translations will be added as the game progresses. Now, something REALLY IMPORTANT, I will be using google translate and other sites and programs to make those translations, I do not speak those languages fluently, so, it's bound to have grammar mistakes, I'll be trying my best to make everything fit with those languages, in case you end up finding mistakes and wants to help, you are free to create a Community Discussion or send me through Discord or Patreon so I can fix them.
 
New Translations to be added:
-French
-Spanish
-Italian
-Russian
-Japanese


[h1]More Songs[/h1]
More songs have been added to the soundtrack. Besides that, the soundtrack has been changed to fit the current scene setting being displayed, a tense scene, a tense music, romantic scene, romantic music and so on.

[h1]More Secret Photos[/h1]
The Imps are getting out of control, 17 new Secret Photos are available! 

[h1]Donation DLC[/h1]
A donation DLC will be available for those that want to support the game even more. 
The DLC gives you a thematic Model Book PDF that features the some of the game women in a summer photo-shoot for Angela's company.
World Lore PDF, detailing more of the Faye species in the game.
10 4K Wallpaper Renders, available on both 3840 x 2160 (4K) and 1920 x 1080 (Full HD).

notes.title: News Report and Next Update Previews
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! First, I would like to apologize for the wait. The new update is almost complete, I'm working on the technical part, coding and music. The update took this long because I was very unsatisfied and frustrated with the renders quality, I hated the lighting and camera work. For the last months I've been working to get better at those and stop using Photoshop to fill that gap, you will find a few scenes that look different because of that. In the future, I'll take a update specifically to remake those scenes that don't look good enough. 

That being said, let's go to the good news, this update will have the complete Chapter 1 and Chapter 2 Part 1 available, instead of just Chapter 1. 
The writing for the second part of Chapter 2 is done, all that's left are the renders.
The general writing is done for Chapter 3.
Romance paths for Sam, Cherry and a few other characters are fully writing too!
Chapter 3 will be very big and it will focus on the romances, with the story/questline of each woman, you can decide if you will get involved and help them with their issues or not. Each path is unique and expands more of the world and a few secondary women will only show up in specific paths.

My work has been very exhausting and tiring, but now that July is coming, I'll be having my vacation and will be totally free, so I'll be able to focus 100% on the game and also make new content to post on my socials. 

Before the update comes out, I'll post the changelog, but a I added more songs for the soundtrack during Chapter 1, some for specific moments like tense, spicy, calm, romance and so on. Bunch of new secret photos.

Reminder: Make a save before Celine meeting/Entering the Coffee shop, there is a new secret photo there if you don't to miss it and a small scene after the meeting that is related to the story.

Chapter 2 Part 1 will focus on the introduction of the members of the Beneventi Family and their dynamic. 
The complete Chapter 2 shouldn't take long to come out with me being free for July and already having the writing done in advance, I can even add a small part of Chapter 3 if possible.

Stay with previews of the next update.

notes.title: A Touch of Magic / Steam Release
notes.notes:
A Touch of Magic Chapter One - Part One is available!

A Touch of Magic is an interactive visual novel set in the fictional city, Solestra Hills, a safe heaven for Fayes, magical beings that have been living among the humans for a long time, all thanks to the Eight Families. You will be playing as a young man and the owner of the nightclub, First Sin, Giovanni Beneventi (You can change the name).

On a day like any other, you receive a visit from the elder of the Nobunaga Family, Hideo, who asks your help to hide and protect a young Nephilim, a being of extreme magical power, but everything goes out of control when Hideo is murdered and you are the prime suspect. Now it's up to you to protect the young Nephilim, discover the truth about the murder and reconnect with your past. All of that while having lots of fun with many women.
